0022600091.text: Both the Dallas Mavericks and the Houston Rockets open their 2026-27 seasons, and the Mavericks, who are on the road, have four day-to-day players who are game-time decisions: Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Jett Howard (illness), Santi Aldama (knee), and Tarik Biberovic (heel). Houston also has two day-to-day players who are game-time decisions, Julian Phillips (illness) and Steven Adams (calf soreness). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the most recent meeting was a 111-107 Mavericks loss in Houston on January 31, 2026, with no games yet in the 2026-27 series.
